recipe.visualDefinition: A central sepia-toned photograph of a child in a cowboy costume is framed by a thick black border, with bold, condensed typography overlapping the top and bottom edges of the image area.
coreVisualRelationships: Text overlapping the image frame to create depth
High contrast between the pale blue/cream text and the dark textured background
Warm sepia tones in the central photo against a cold black distressed frame
Geometric rigidity of the layout vs. the organic texture of the vintage photo
coreInvariants: Thick black outer border with visible distressing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A child in a cowboy hat occupies the central 60% of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, pale blue 'N' and 'L' characters that anchor the top and bottom text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top name, moves down to the central figure, and rests on the bottom title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounding the central image acts as a structural frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal black with scratch textures for the background frame.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm sepia and muted reds for the central photographic subject.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale powder blue used for the primary display characters.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; high value contrast between the text and the black background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to sepia, black, and pale blue

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with slight variations in the 'L' and 'N'
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial letters for names and titles
Lower-case 'd' in the bottom title is scaled down to fit between larger capitals

composition.position: Top and bottom edges of the central image

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scales of the same condensed sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square sepia-toned vintage photograph of a child in a cowboy hat holding toy pistols. Place this image inside a thick, distressed black frame that has subtle vertical scratches and wear marks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed sans-serif text in pale blue and cream. The text should be positioned at the top and bottom edges of the inner photo, partially overlapping the black frame and the photo itself.

verificationChecks: Is the text overlapping the image border?
Is the background frame distressed black?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distressing on the black frame
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the child
Exact wording of the artist name and title
Specific placement of scratches in the texture

mustAchieve: Clean typographic execution despite the distressed background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the background
Check that the 'sepia' doesn't look like a simple orange filter
Confirm the distressed texture looks organic, not tiled
recipe.reuseFormula: Central vintage photo + thick distressed black frame + overlapping ultra-condensed sans-serif typography in muted tones.
